content:
amy: kicking off preflight for release stable/2026.03.20 — starting staged ramp to 25% now. will watch SLOs for 10m, please call out anomalies.

deploy-bot: preflight run started · monitoring links -> https://dash.redwood/inflight/1769998888 · baseline p95 threshold = 300ms · will post updates every 60s.

raj: seeing p95 jump to ~620ms in eu-west-1 around the 2m mark. quick eyeball: https://dash.redwood/graph?p95_eu-west (spike aligns with burst of requests).

sara: are we seeing 5xx or 429s?

raj: mostly 429 from the rate-limiter, a few timeouts. sample host log: ```[2026-03-21T10:04:12Z] host-12 kubeproxy: POST /generate 429 rate_limiter:exceeded KVCache timeout after=150ms```

amy: pausing the ramp — hold new traffic. do not push further until we pin or clear.

amy: proposal: pin eu-west traffic back to variant v2026-03-18 (pre-quant) while we triage. safer to isolate region impact.

mike: agree. if it's a rate-limiter interaction with quantized kernels, pinning is safest.

sara: command to pin (if you have perms): `deployctl pin --region eu-west --route stable --version v2026-03-18`

mike: running that now...

deploy-bot: traffic policy update requested by mike. applying...

deploy-bot: traffic policy applied · eu-west: new-version ramp -> 0% · global staged ramp -> 10% (reduced) · link: https://deploy.redwood/changes/1769998888

raj: after shift eu-west p95 back to ~280ms. queues drained, errors reduced.

amy: great. we'll continue diagnostics on the new hosts off-route.

amy: action items: raj = collect full model-host logs + QPS by shard; infra-ops = validate rate-limiter config and token bucket settings; sara = file release-note entry marking the pinned rollback and investigation.

sara: creating GH issue now with logs + screenshots. GH #4321 created: https://github.com/redwood/ops/issues/4321

mike: confirmed deployctl success and no further errors in eu-west.

amy: we'll wait 30m after triage to consider a slow resume. leave a message here when you want to attempt a controlled ramp to 15%.

sara: done, GH issue has initial triage notes and owner tags.

mike: :thumbsup:

amy: thanks everyone — nice quick response. will follow up with RCA once logs are in.

(opsbot): note: pinned version v2026-03-18 on stable route in eu-west by mike at 2026-03-21T10:06:15Z.
